global_rules: Every color on every component MUST use an Alias Token. Never use a Parent Token directly.
3-Layer token chain: Component → Alias Token (Color Tokens collection) → Parent Token (Colors collection) → Hex value.
Correct: use alias token (e.g. input background → Surface/Secondary). Incorrect: parent token (Greys/Grey-900) or raw hex (#1F1F1F) on a component.

Violation rule: if a raw hex value or a parent token name (e.g. Greys/Grey-900, Brand/Brand-600-main) appears directly on a component, flag it as a violation and replace it with the correct alias token.
Always use only the typescales defined in the design system when building any component, screen, or layout.
Figtree is the functional UI typeface — used for all UI text (headings, labels, paragraphs, links, inputs, error states); not italic.
Awesome Serif Italic is a stylised expressive typeface, always italic by nature — do not apply italic as a separate style; it is baked into every variant.
Awesome Serif Italic is reserved for expressive headings, section titles, editorial labels, marketing/promotional copy, and hero banners only.
Awesome Serif Italic is NEVER used for body text, input labels, helper text, error/success states, or any functional UI text.
Awesome Serif Italic letter spacing: 0% at 20px and above, 2% at 16px and below.
Always reference spacing/radius/stroke tokens by name. Never hardcode raw pixel values in components.
Spacing/Radius/Stroke chain: Component property (padding, gap, border-radius, etc.) → token (e.g. Spacing/16, Radius/12, Strokes/x2) → pixel value.
Violation rule: if a raw pixel value appears directly on a component property (padding, gap, radius, stroke) instead of a token name, flag it as a violation and replace it with the correct token.
Use Small glow variants for inline elements, badges, and icons.
Use Large glow variants for full cards, surfaces, and prominent CTAs.
Do not use deprecated effect styles marked 'not used' (e.g. Glow-Primary-Invert/Medium, Glow-Blue-Small) in new component designs.
Background blur styles are only for overlay/modal contexts — not flat surfaces.
Background blur values are Figma-specific units, not CSS pixel values — do not translate directly to blur(Npx); confirm equivalent CSS values with dev handoff.
Slot: a blank placeholder component with no visual style; place it directly in layouts, then swap the component inside it via the component swap property.

Slot Container: never placed/used directly in a layout; to add content, double-click into the container, navigate inside to the Slot, then swap the component inside the Slot. Always go one level deeper to the Slot — never swap content directly on a Slot Container.
Icons: always place icons inside an Icon Wrapper; never use raw icon components directly in a layout.
Use the Icon Wrapper size that matches context (12, 16, 20, 24, 28px); do not freehand resize an icon outside the wrapper system.
If an icon is tappable, use Icon Button (provides correct 40px touch target), not Icon Wrapper which is display-only.
Always apply icon colour using a colour token; never hardcode a colour value.
Outline icons (Icons/) are the default; use Filled icons (Filled Icons/) only for active, selected, or toggled-on states.

Illustration icons are PNG assets — never use them as functional/interactive icons; never recolour them or apply colour tokens/CSS filters. Two sizes: 100x100px (inline/contextual) and 393x209px (full-width). Figma prefix Illustration/, export from icons/illustration/.
Logos (Logos/) are brand marks — never recolour them.

UPI app logos are third-party brand assets — never recolour, tint, or filter them; render at fixed 48x48px (do not scale); do not bind to any colour token; use as PNG only (do not convert to SVG or edit). Figma prefix Banks/, export from icons/upi-logos/.
